report.explanation: Current telemetry is healthy and contradicts a fault: checkout trace OK at 65ms, gateway 200/ok, payment error_rate 0.0012 with p95 71ms and zero timeouts/pool waiters. The order deployment (3.3.9, 1603 min old) cannot establish latency causation. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause, so no bounded candidate is substantiated; hand off for operator review.
missing_evidence: Sustained error-rate or latency degradation aligned to checkout/order over a longer window
Dependency-level timeout or pool-wait evidence for order's downstreams (inventory, payment, postgresql)
Logs from order/payment/inventory showing errors or retries during the alert window
Memory-retention time series per service to assess a leak trend
